translationRepairs: In the seventeenth year, an edict stated: "For zongguan and baihu of the Cross-River [campaign] who were promoted for merit, the zongguan inherited by descending one grade from qianhu; for the baihu, if there was no successive lower title, they kept their original grade."

In the seventeenth year, an edict stated: "For zongba and baihu of the Cross-River [campaign] who were promoted for merit, the zongba inherited by descending one grade from qianhu; for the baihu, if there was no successive lower title, they kept their original grade."
總把 is zongba (company commander), distinct from 總管 zongguan; both mentions in this edict are 總把.

A marshal’s or pacification commissioner’s descendant would become a wanhu; a zongguan’s descendant a qianhu; a zongguan’s descendant a baihu—and would receive the original gold or silver tally of office.

A marshal’s or pacification commissioner’s descendant would become a wanhu; a zongguan’s descendant a qianhu; a zongba’s descendant a baihu—and would receive the original gold or silver tally of office.
總把子孫為百戶: the third item is 總把 zongba, not a second 總管.
The Secretariat deliberated: "Apart from treasury managers and deputies consulted and selected by each province, supervisors were selected and registered by the provincial ministry."
The Secretariat deliberated: "Apart from treasury managers and deputies consulted and selected by each province, supervisors were selected and registered by the Secretariat and ministries."
省部 is the Central Secretariat together with its ministries, not a provincial ministry.

In the first year of Dade, the province drafted: "Officers of the four Dadu Trillion Treasuries, Funing Treasury, Paper-Note General Treasury, and Shangdu Trillion Treasury: only select and register according to due qualification and rank; must complete two years with no shortage; draft promotion one grade like the court-attendant precedent."

In the first year of Dade, the Secretariat drafted: "Officers of the four Dadu Trillion Treasuries, Funing Treasury, Paper-Note General Treasury, and Shangdu Trillion Treasury: only select and register according to due qualification and rank; must complete two years with no shortage; draft promotion one grade like the court-attendant precedent."
省 here is the Central Secretariat (都省), not a province.

In the second year, the province deliberated: "Shangdu and Yingchang granary officers, compared with the Trillion Treasury officer precedent: two years is full; draft promotion one grade above due qualification and rank."

In the second year, the Secretariat deliberated: "Shangdu and Yingchang granary officers, compared with the Trillion Treasury officer precedent: two years is full; draft promotion one grade above due qualification and rank."
省議 is a deliberation of the Central Secretariat, not a province.

On promotion and transfer of tax officers: in the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan, the province deliberated: "Revenue officers to be ranked in three grades: above one hundred ingots, establish one supervisor and one commissioner.

On promotion and transfer of tax officers: in the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan, the Secretariat deliberated: "Revenue officers to be ranked in three grades: above one hundred ingots, establish one supervisor and one commissioner.
省議 is a deliberation of the Central Secretariat, not a province.
In the twenty-ninth year the province set promotions and demotions based on revenue increase and deficit figures.
In the twenty-ninth year the Secretariat set promotions and demotions based on revenue increase and deficit figures.
省判 is a ruling of the Central Secretariat.

In the thirtieth year, the province drafted: "Supervisor two years is full; provincial ministry selects and registers from regular officials; above ten thousand ingots draft rank 6b, above five thousand draft rank 7a, above two thousand draft rank 7b, above one thousand draft rank 8a, above five hundred draft rank 8b.

In the thirtieth year, the Secretariat drafted: "Supervisor two years is full; the Secretariat and Ministry select and registers from regular officials; above ten thousand ingots draft rank 6b, above five thousand draft rank 7a, above two thousand draft rank 7b, above one thousand draft rank 8a, above five hundred draft rank 8b.
省擬 is a Central Secretariat draft and 省部 is the Secretariat with its ministry, not a provincial ministry.
The province approved: "When credentials arrive at the ministry, select from among personnel with complete joint verification.
The Secretariat approved: "When credentials arrive at the ministry, select from among personnel with complete joint verification.
省準 is approval by the Central Secretariat, not a province.
The province deliberated: "Except where under the metropolitan Directorate-General, follow the draft.
The Secretariat deliberated: "Except where under the metropolitan Directorate-General, follow the draft.
省議 is a deliberation of the Central Secretariat, not a province.

In the fourth year, a provincial writ stated: "Officials due to receive seals—if they hold imperial appointment, princely orders, appanage officers' endorsements, or writs from the Secretariat, provincial offices, Privy Council, or Offices of the Left and Right—verify households and grant the seal."

In the fourth year, a Secretariat writ stated: "Officials due to receive seals—if they hold imperial appointment, princely orders, appanage officers' endorsements, or writs from the Secretariat, provincial offices, Privy Council, or Offices of the Left and Right—verify households and grant the seal."
省劄 is a writ of the Central Secretariat.

Provincial ministers memorialized: "Jiangnan princely appanage chiefs have already been ordered to rotate according to regulation; among them, if some also command troops and garrison as darughachi, replacing them as one body seems unsuitable.

Secretariat ministers memorialized: "Jiangnan princely appanage chiefs have already been ordered to rotate according to regulation; among them, if some also command troops and garrison as darughachi, replacing them as one body seems unsuitable.
省臣 are ministers of the Central Secretariat.

On grain-for-office appointments: in the third year of Tianli, when the people of Henan, Shaanxi, and other places suffered famine, provincial ministers deliberated: "Wealthy households in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Henan, and other places who wish to donate grain for offices—verify grain amounts by grade, have the grain donor transport grain to the disaster area, immediately issue tallies and vermilion notes, substantively appoint tea-salt circulating officials, and consult the Secretariat and ministries for appointment.

On grain-for-office appointments: in the third year of Tianli, when the people of Henan, Shaanxi, and other places suffered famine, Secretariat ministers deliberated: "Wealthy households in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Henan, and other places who wish to donate grain for offices—verify grain amounts by grade, have the grain donor transport grain to the disaster area, immediately issue tallies and vermilion notes, substantively appoint tea-salt circulating officials, and consult the Secretariat and ministries for appointment.
省臣 are ministers of the Central Secretariat, not provincial officials.
